fullPassage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed, few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth: for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader: not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfillment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.

questions.passage: A serious (A)[deterioration / improvement] in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even (C)[narrower / broader]: not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfillment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.

② deterioration — weaken — broader: 원문 일치 ←정답

④ improvement — weaken — broader: improvement는 deterioration의 반의어

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed, few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth: for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both __________. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader: not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfillment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많은 사람들에게 일은 소득과 의미의 원천(a source of income and of meaning) 두 가지 모두다.
det.analysis:
① a source of income and of meaning: 원문 일치 ←정답
② a cause of inequality and disturbance: 본문 단어이나 work의 기능 설명 문맥에 부적합
③ a way to share out the fruits of growth: 본문 단어이나 work의 개인적 의미가 아닌 사회적 역할
④ a sign of technological unemployment: 본문 단어이나 work를 설명하는 게 아님
det.tip: a source of = ~의 원천 (income + meaning 두 가지 모두)
